exposure: Laparoscopic repair of previous cesarean scar defect
laparoscopic repair of previous cesarean scar defect (PCSD)
hysteroscopic resection of previous cesarean scar defect (PCSD)
Hysteroscopic resection of previous cesarean scar defect
cohort: 62 patients presenting with previous cesarean scar defect-related postmenstrual bleeding
finding: Both hysteroscopic resection and laparoscopic repair were effective in reducing postmenstrual bleeding related to previous cesarean scar defect, but hysteroscopic resection was associated with shorter operative time, less blood loss, and shorter hospital stay.
